<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<addon id="plugin.video.xtreammate"
       name="XCMate"
       version="0.1.29.74"
       provider-name="GS Media">

  <requires>
    <import addon="xbmc.python" version="3.0.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.pil" version="5.1.0"/>
    <import addon="script.module.requests" version="2.27.0" optional="true"/>

</requires>

  <extension point="xbmc.python.pluginsource" library="default.py">
    <provides>video audio</provides>
  </extension>

  <extension point="xbmc.service" library="service.py" start="startup"/>

  <extension point="xbmc.addon.metadata">
    <summary lang="en_GB">XCMate – TV setup wizard for Xtream, M3U and Stalker</summary>
    <summary lang="de_DE">XCMate – IPTV-Einrichtungsassistent mit Xtream, M3U und Stalker</summary>
    <description lang="en_GB">
      Independent GPL-licensed derivative of mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi, featuring a guided IPTV import process and on-video remote-control live channel and category navigation.
      Features: Multiple M3U playlists, Xtream Codes API (Live/VOD/Series),
      XMLTV EPG, channel groups, favourites, search, catch-up, recordings,
      reminders, sleep timer.
    </description>
    <description lang="de_DE">
      Eigenständiger GPL-Fork von mr-evil1 TiViMate Kodi mit geführter IPTV-Einrichtung und Fernbedienungssteuerung über laufendem Live-TV.
      Funktionen: Mehrere M3U-Playlists, Xtream-Codes-API (Live/VOD/Serien),
      XMLTV-EPG, Sendergruppen, Favoriten, Suche, Catch-up, Aufnahmen,
      Erinnerungen, Sleep-Timer.
    </description>
    <platform>all</platform>
    <license>GPL-2.0-only</license>
    <defaultlanguage>resource.language.en_gb</defaultlanguage>
    <forum>https://forum.kodi.tv</forum>
    <website>https://kodi.tv</website>
    <source>https://github.com/artattakk-creator/kodi-noodleprivate</source>
    <news>German and English language support; Language filter; Xtream auto-detection; Parallel search</news>
    <assets>
      <icon>icon-81da1003a2753ec6.png</icon>
      <fanart>resources/media/lightweight_splash.jpg</fanart>
    </assets>
  </extension>

</addon>

0.1.29.74 (Test-Build, Issue #361)

0.1.29.73 (Test-Build, Issues #357 / #358 / #359)

- Fehlende Kategorien gezielt nachfordern und gruppenbezogenen Importstatus anzeigen; Sicherung und frischer Datenbank-Readback.
- Gespeicherte BINGIE-Widgetverknüpfungen diagnostizieren und vorhandene Home-Konfiguration ausdrücklich neu aufbauen.

0.1.29.72 (Test-Build, Issue #355)

- Inkrementeller Titelabgleich, private Sicherung, geprüfter Readback und Abbruch ohne Teilgruppen.
- Live-TV, EPG, Favoriten, Serienfortschritt und gespeicherte Zugangsdaten bleiben erhalten.

- Sendungsbilder: HTTPS-URL vorab im gemeinsamen Event-Index sichern; keine Bilderrecherche bei Fokus oder Details.
- Live-Navigation: verwaiste Übergabesperre lösen und wartende eigene Übergabe mit Zurück abbrechen.
- Wizard .54 und gespeicherte Passwörter, Portale, EPG, Cover und Profile bleiben erhalten.

0.1.29.54
- Installation erfolgreich: Popup zeigt installierte Version und konkrete Änderungen.

0.1.29.52
- EPG: einheitliches 7/20-Kalendertage-Fenster im Master und gemeinsamen Datenbestand.
- Quellqualifizierte Lücken-/Metadaten-Ergänzung mit bewahrtem Last-Good-Bestand.
- Nachträglicher Seriengruppenimport mit Wiederanlauf, Fortschritt und Abbruch.
- Gerahmte echte Stream-Pixelauflösung; Übergangswerte bleiben unbekannt.
- Keine Daten-/Profilresets, keine Skinmodifikation; Android-Abnahme offen.

0.1.29.51
- Wizard: bestätigte Übernahme der neuen Portal-Settings, fehlende Angaben ergänzen.
- Gruppenlisten lazy und in begrenzten Owner-Pump-Schritten; Auswahl ohne Add-on-Abfragen pro Zeile.
- Neutrale Wizard-Schaltflächen, sichtbarer Fortschritt, sichere Abbruch-/Worker-Sperre.
- Bestehende Portale, Daten und Live-TV-/BINGIE-Funktionen unverändert. Android-Abnahme offen.

0.1.29.50 (explicit BINGIE Home integration; Android NOT_TESTED)
- #252: three direct Live TV / Movies / Series choices prepare a verified native
  Skinshortcuts Home slot. Preserve occupied movie/series bindings and reload hooks.
  Explicit confirmation, private original/candidate SHA256, safe restore.
- Four-file opt-in BINGIE 2.2.3 adapter: real Home programme Hero and small
  horizontal station logos, plus direct native widget candidates. No automatic
  skin/profile modification, startup apply or native player rewrite.
- Live Home reads only the explicitly configured start group from the shared local
  EPG/artwork data. Full group, no provider/category fallback, focus never tunes.
- Prior widget source folders and .48 preview remain compatibility functions.

0.1.29.49 (widget selection hotfix #252; Android NOT_TESTED)
- Settings > Appearance and display > Widgets lists three real folders:
  Live TV - start group, Movies - latest movies, Series - latest series.
- BINGIE/skinshortcuts can browse and select the existing widget endpoints;
  the skin's own picker saves the binding. No plugin-URL textviewer substitute.
- Correct German menu names, explicit native save instructions, and compatibility
  for bookmarked RunPlugin entries. Existing status/Hero preview remain separate.
- No skin/profile edits or widget URL/reload-hook changes; preserve all .48 data,
  media widgets and their automatic refresh. No automatic installation or merge.

0.1.29.48 (cumulative review candidate; Android .48 NOT_TESTED)
- #250/#249: OS-held service singleton, local-first startup phases, bounded
  maintenance and optional network prefetch. No claim of a proven native
  Android crash fix without a crash/ANR trace and device acceptance.
- Wizard: direct setup entry without full router/root reloading; stale owner
  protection, finite native-init/discovery deadlines, 3s request timeout and no
  discovery retries. Xtream authentication now makes one request, not two.
- Wizard Save preserves committed EPG source archive, XMLTV images, cast,
  director and additive common facts; external-only sources retain correct rank.
  Existing populated guides remain behind the verified-backup gate.
- Preserve the .42 native Live Stop strategy. Pending exit has service priority;
  completed exits do not starve movie/widget refresh. Home-origin playback
  returns to Kodi Home without recursively dispatching the plugin root.
- Source-qualified EPG assignment directly from Guide context or visible button:
  real grid preview in RAM, explicit Save/Cancel, legacy mapping compatibility.
- Propagate verified rich event data, protect direct XMLTV icons from nested
  rating icons, rotate event-art jobs independently of widget repaint, require
  the image decoder dependency and add bounded privacy-safe evidence.
- Covermanager uses existing candidates immediately, supports verified offline
  choices and explicit provider refresh; safe credentialless public image
  redirects revalidate DNS/TLS, deny downgrade/private hosts and limit hops.
- Native Live-only sender-strip/large-Hero preview. Optional BINGIE include is
  REVIEW_ONLY / BLOCKED_SKIN_INTEGRATION pending actual skin review/approval.
  Working movie/series widgets, native click paths and reload hooks unchanged.
- No reset, no existing image deletion, no device action, no auto-merge/release.

0.1.29.47 (cumulative review candidate; Android .47 NOT_TESTED)
- #244/#245: movie payloads use complete primary-key seeks, with one pinned
  read-only transaction and a strict active-SQL budget. Cold imports no longer
  consume a query deadline; the successful series SQL/data contract is retained.
- Reject only superseded derived movie snapshots; real Empty/Unavailable is
  not rendered as a fake XCMate film tile. Numeric movie InfoTags normalized.
- Keep genuine station images in native Live tiles when programme artwork is
  absent; preserve the separate programme picture/logo properties and all
  88 Android-confirmed start-group senders. No automatic BINGIE skin changes.
- Shared .46 SQLite gains additive channel/asset/diagnostic references. Existing
  guide, settings, mappings, images and manual-choice manifests remain intact.
  Dynamic movie covers stay dynamic; no new persistent provider cover archive.
- Page-scoped thread-local read snapshots and background channel/index models
  remove repeated database reconnections and GUI catalog construction.
- Common event IDs survive Guide/Mini/Infobar/Widget reads and RAM Now/Next
  rollover. Verified existing programme facts remain available as LastGood.
- Explicit cover Save mirrors an extension-correct verified display reference
  into the common layer while preserving the original chosen image.
- Independent widget failure handling, private count/stage diagnostics and
  exact population/decoder limitations. References are not a rendering PASS.

import threading

_local_once48=set()
_stop=threading.Event()


def refresh_local(cancel=lambda:False):
    from startup48 import suspended
    if suspended():return
    from widget_hooks45 import prepare as prepare_widget_bindings
    prepare_widget_bindings()
    if cancel():return
    from portals import get_active
    from xtream import XtreamClient

    for portal in get_active():
        if cancel():return
        if portal.get('type') not in ('xtream','m3u','stb'): continue
        if time.monotonic()<_retry_after.get(portal['id'],0): continue
        try:
            if portal['type']=='xtream': client=XtreamClient(portal['xc_host'],portal['xc_user'],portal['xc_pass'])
            else:
                from source_adapters import for_portal
                client=for_portal(portal)
            from catalog_delta52 import reconcile_series
            reconcile_series(portal)
            if portal['type']=='xtream' and not hasattr(client,'iter_catalog'):
                refresh(portal,client)
            elif portal['id'] not in _bootstrapped:
                from catalog_sync import request
                from library_index import Reader
                existing=Reader(portal['id'])
                for kind in ('live','vod','series'):
                    if cancel():return
                    if portal.get('include_'+kind,True) and not existing.state(kind):
                        request(portal,kind,portal.get('start_group_id','') if kind=='live' else '',priority=20)
                _bootstrapped.add(portal['id'])
            from guide_store import refresh as refresh_guide
            if cancel():return
            from programme_index46 import prepare_local as prepare_programmes46
            prepare_programmes46(portal,cancel)
            try:
                if portal['id'] not in _local_once48:
                    refresh_guide(portal);_local_once48.add(portal['id'])
            except Exception:
                from utils import warn
                warn('GUIDE_PREWARM_UNAVAILABLE')
            if cancel():return
            # Bounded indexed widget pages replace full-catalogue rail COUNTs.
            # Prepare references in this long-lived data worker, not IR/render.
            from widget_home_probe59 import prepare as prepare_home59
            prepare_home59(portal['id'])
            from widget_data41 import snapshot
            from widget_art44 import prepare
            for kind in ('live','vod','series'):
                if cancel():return
                try:
                    rows,code=snapshot(portal,kind,background=True)
                    if kind=='live':
                        from widget_home50 import rows as start_group_rows56
                        previous_code56=code;rows,code=start_group_rows56(portal)
                        if previous_code56=='READ_ONLY' and code=='READY':code='READ_ONLY'
                    from widget_diagnostics47 import inspect_index
                    inspect_index(portal,kind,rows,code)
                    if kind=='live':
                        from programme_prefetch48 import prepare as prefetch_events48
                        prefetch_events48(portal,rows,cancel)
                    try:
                        prepare(portal['id'],rows)
                        from programme_assets47 import prepare as prepare_assets47
                        prepare_assets47(portal,kind,rows,cancel,provider_only=kind in ('vod','series'))
                    except Exception:
                        from widget_diagnostics47 import note
                        note(portal['id'],kind,'ASSETS','PREPARE_UNAVAILABLE')
                    if cancel():return
                    from widget_live47 import publish
                    publish(portal,kind,rows,code)
                except Exception:
                    # A failed Live/film preparation must not starve the
                    # successful series row or another independent widget.
                    from widget_diagnostics47 import note
                    note(portal['id'],kind,'SELECT','WORKER_UNAVAILABLE')
            _retry_after.pop(portal['id'],None)
        except Exception as exc:
            # A disk-full/over-budget/corrupt import must not reparse the same
            # large local snapshot every 15 seconds. Explicit UI requests are
            # independent; automatic retries wait five minutes.
            _retry_after[portal['id']]=time.monotonic()+300
            from utils import warn
            warn('Local library index: '+type(exc).__name__)

        if suspended():

            continue
        if runtime.pressure():

            if runtime.wait_abort(monitor,.5,_stop):break
            continue
        worked=False

        except Exception:pass
        try:
            from widget_notice46 import focused
            focused()
        except Exception:pass
        prepare_now=time.monotonic()>=next_prepare
        if phases48.network() and phases48.due('maintenance',300):
            next_prepare=time.monotonic()+5
            try:
                from artwork_db import maintain
                maintain(cancel=cancelled)
            except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
            except Exception:pass
        if cancelled():break
        # Persisted image jobs resume even when catalogue warming is disabled

        try:

            if phases48.network():ensure_worker()
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception:pass
        if cancelled():break
        if prepare_now and phases48.network():

            # Optional guide/art preparation may fail independently. It must not
            # starve an otherwise valid movie/series sync request.
            started48=time.monotonic()
            try:
                refresh_local(cancelled)
                mark('LOCAL',duration_ms=(time.monotonic()-started48)*1000)
                next_prepare=time.monotonic()+30  # Finish + cooldown, never an already elapsed start deadline.
            except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
            except Exception: pass
            if cancelled():break
            try:
                from art_store import prefetch_selected
                if phases48.network() and phases48.due('prefetch',300):prefetch_selected()
            except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
            except Exception: pass
            if cancelled():break
            try:
                from startup_preload import prepare
                if phases48.network():prepare(cancel=cancelled)
            except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
            except Exception: pass
            if cancelled():break
        try:
            from catalog_delta import run_next as run_delta
            worked=run_delta(cancelled) or worked
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception:pass
        try:
            from catalog_sync import run_next
            worked=run_next(cancelled) or worked
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception: pass
        if cancelled():break
        try:
            from catalog_jobs73 import run_next as catalog_job73
            worked=catalog_job73(cancelled) or worked
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception:pass
        if cancelled():break
        try:
            from genre_search import run_next as index_genres
            worked=index_genres(cancelled) or worked
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception:pass
        if cancelled():break
        try:
            from catalog_progress73 import prepare as catalog_progress73
            catalog_progress73()
        except Exception:pass
        try:
            from guide_timers import poll as poll_timers
            poll_timers()
        except MemoryError:runtime.note_pressure()
        except Exception: pass
        if runtime.wait_abort(monitor,0.1 if worked else .5,_stop):break


def poll():
    if _stop.is_set():return
    from app_imports46 import ensure as imports_ready46
    if not imports_ready46():return
    from widget_notice46 import poll as poll_widget_lists
    poll_widget_lists()
    from catalog_progress73 import poll as poll_catalog73
    poll_catalog73()
    from guide_backup44 import poll as poll_guide_backup
    poll_guide_backup()
    from app_entry import observe
    observe()
    global _worker
    if _stop.is_set():return
    runtime.install()
    from stability_monitor import ensure
    ensure()
    from capture_service import poll as poll_captures
    poll_captures()
    from downloads import poll as poll_downloads
    poll_downloads()
    with _guard:
        if _stop.is_set():return
        if _worker is None or not _worker.is_alive():
            _worker=threading.Thread(target=_run,name='XCMate-library',daemon=True)
            _worker.start()
    from media_autoplay import poll as poll_autoplay
    poll_autoplay()
    from media_progress import poll as poll_media
    poll_media()

    from media_osd import poll as poll_osd
    poll_osd()


def shutdown():
    """Prevent new optional work; never block Kodi waiting on provider IO.

    Already running non-cancellable HTTP may outlive this bounded join. That
    limitation is reported explicitly, rather than claiming a forced stop.
    """
    _stop.set()
    from epg_refresh74 import shutdown as shutdown_epg74
    shutdown_epg74()
    from widget_fast69 import shutdown as shutdown_widgets69
    shutdown_widgets69()
    from programme_requests68 import shutdown as shutdown_visible68
    shutdown_visible68()
    from programme_art46 import shutdown as shutdown_programme46
    from programme_urls55 import shutdown as shutdown_urls55
    shutdown_urls55()
    shutdown_programme46()
    for name in ('downloads','capture_service','media_art'):
        event=getattr(__import__(name),'_stop',None)
        if event is not None:event.set()
    runtime.stop()
    from media_art import shutdown as shutdown_art
    shutdown_art(timeout=.05)
    from stability_monitor import shutdown as shutdown_monitor
    shutdown_monitor()
    from capture_service import shutdown as shutdown_captures
    shutdown_captures()
    from downloads import shutdown as shutdown_downloads
    shutdown_downloads()
    with _guard:
        _stop.set();worker=_worker
    if worker is not None and worker is not threading.current_thread():worker.join(timeout=.2)
    candidates=[worker]+[t for t in threading.enumerate() if t is not threading.current_thread() and (t.name.startswith('XCMate') or t.name.startswith('epg_warmup_') or t.name.startswith('ThreadPoolExecutor'))]
    stopped=all(t is None or not t.is_alive() for t in candidates)
    from boot_diagnostics import mark
    mark('APP_WORKER_STOPPED' if stopped else 'APP_WORKER_STOP_PENDING')
    return stopped

import json
import os
import sqlite3
import time
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit

_cursor = {}
_visual_revision47=0
TABLES = {
    'asset_refs47': '''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS asset_refs47(
        pid TEXT,kind TEXT,sid TEXT,role TEXT,fingerprint TEXT,data TEXT,expires REAL,
        PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,sid,role))''',
    'channels47': '''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS channels47(
        pid TEXT,sid TEXT,canonical TEXT,data TEXT,updated REAL,PRIMARY KEY(pid,sid))''',
    'widget_diagnostics47': '''CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS widget_diagnostics47(
        pid TEXT,kind TEXT,stage TEXT,data TEXT,updated REAL,PRIMARY KEY(pid,kind,stage))''',
}
COLUMNS = {
    'asset_refs47': ('pid','kind','sid','role','fingerprint','data','expires'),
    'channels47': ('pid','sid','canonical','data','updated'),
    'widget_diagnostics47': ('pid','kind','stage','data','updated'),
}


def station_image(uri):
    """Only our actual bundled placeholders are non-logos, not any tv.png."""
    if not isinstance(uri,str) or not uri:return False
    root=os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(__file__)))
    if uri.startswith('special://home/addons/plugin.video.xtreammate/'):
        uri=os.path.join(root,uri[len('special://home/addons/plugin.video.xtreammate/'):])
    placeholders={os.path.join(root,'resources','media',name) for name in ('tv.png','vod.png','series.png')}
    placeholders.update(os.path.join(root,name) for name in ('icon.png','icon-81da1003a2753ec6.png'))
    return uri not in placeholders


def writer():
    from programme_index46 import connect
    db = connect(True)
    try:
        db.execute('SAVEPOINT assets47')
        for name, sql in TABLES.items():
            db.execute(sql)
            if tuple(r[1] for r in db.execute('PRAGMA table_info('+name+')')) != COLUMNS[name]:
                raise ValueError('UNSUPPORTED_ASSET_SCHEMA')
        db.execute('RELEASE assets47')
        return db
    except Exception:
        db.rollback()
        db.close()
        raise


def local_uri(uri):
    """Normalize Kodi/Android file paths; no network, decode or file creation."""
    if not isinstance(uri, str) or not uri or len(uri)>8192 or any(ord(c)<32 for c in uri):
        return ''
    if uri.startswith('special://'):
        try:
            import xbmcvfs
            uri = xbmcvfs.translatePath(uri)
        except (ImportError, AttributeError, RuntimeError):
            return ''
    elif uri.startswith('file:'):
        parts = urlsplit(uri)
        if parts.netloc or parts.query or parts.fragment:
            return ''
        uri = unquote(parts.path)
    if not os.path.isabs(uri) or os.path.islink(uri):
        return ''
    try:
        if os.path.isfile(uri) and 0<os.path.getsize(uri)<=3*1024*1024:
            return uri
    except OSError:
        pass
    return ''


def sources(row,provider_only=False):
    from media_art import sources as provider

    return {'poster': manual.get('poster') or poster, 'fanart': manual.get('fanart') or fanart}


def fingerprint(source):
    return hashlib.sha256(str(source or '').encode()).hexdigest()


def _store(pid, kind, records):
    global _visual_revision47
    from programme_index46 import encoded, report
    db = None
    try:
        db = writer()
        with db:
            changed=False
            for sid,role,fp,data in records[:128]:
                old=db.execute('SELECT fingerprint,data FROM asset_refs47 WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=? AND role=?',
                               (str(pid),kind,str(sid),role)).fetchone()
                prior=json.loads(old[1]) if old and len(old[1])<=16384 else {}
                if not old or old[0]!=fp or prior.get('uri')!=data.get('uri') or prior.get('code')!=data.get('code'):changed=True
            db.executemany('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO asset_refs47 VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                [(str(pid),kind,str(sid),role,fp,encoded(data),data['until'])
                 for sid,role,fp,data in records[:128]])
        if changed:_visual_revision47+=1
        return True
    except (OSError, sqlite3.Error, ValueError) as error:
        report('art',error)
        return False
    finally:
        if db is not None:
            db.close()


def read_many(pid, kind, rows,provider_only=False):
    """Bounded RO batches. Missing old schema means no optional references."""
    from programme_index46 import connect
    db = None
    result = {}
    try:
        db = connect(False)
        if db is None:
            return result
        deadline = time.monotonic()+.1
        db.set_progress_handler(lambda:int(time.monotonic()>deadline),1000)
        by_sid = {str(r['sid']):r for r in rows}
        keys = list(by_sid)
        for offset in range(0,len(keys),64):
            chunk = keys[offset:offset+64]
            for sid,role,fp,raw,expires in db.execute(
                    'SELECT sid,role,fingerprint,data,expires FROM asset_refs47 '
                    'WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid IN ('+','.join('?' for _ in chunk)+')',
                    [str(pid),kind]+chunk):
                if role not in ('poster','fanart') or expires<=time.time() or len(raw)>16384:
                    continue
                source = sources(by_sid[sid],provider_only).get(role,'')
                if not source or fingerprint(source)!=fp:
                    continue
                value = json.loads(raw)
                if not isinstance(value,dict):
                    continue
                uri = value.get('uri','')
                if value.get('mode')=='dynamic':
                    from artwork_visible import syntactic, KODI_OPTIONS
                    from widget_refs74 import revoked
                    if revoked(source) or not syntactic(source) or uri!=source+KODI_OPTIONS or expires-time.time()>30:
                        continue
                elif not local_uri(uri):
                    continue
                result.setdefault(sid,{})[role]=uri
        return result
    except (OSError, sqlite3.Error, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        return result
    finally:
        # Mutate the returned dictionary even after a read-only DB miss.
        from portals import get_by_id
        from widget_assets69 import read as volatile69
        portal69=get_by_id(str(pid))
        if portal69:
            from widget_refs74 import read as retained74
            kept74=retained74(portal69,kind,rows)
            for sid74,roles74 in kept74.items():
                for role74,uri74 in roles74.items():result.setdefault(sid74,{}).setdefault(role74,uri74)
            for sid69,roles69 in volatile69(portal69,kind,rows).items():
                for role69,uri69 in roles69.items():result.setdefault(sid69,{}).setdefault(role69,uri69)
        if db is not None:
            db.close()


def prepare(portal, kind, rows, cancel=lambda:False,provider_only=False):
    """Finite background approval, including logos beyond the old first 24.

    Existing dynamic DNS expiry and redirect policy are kept. No expired remote
    URI is admitted to a new item; Kodi remains the dynamic texture consumer.
    """
    if not rows or kind not in ('live','vod','series'):
        return
    from widget_assets69 import prepare as provider_refs69
    provider_refs69(portal,kind,rows,cancel)
    from artwork_config import persistent
    from media_art import cached, dimensions
    from artwork_visible import public_dns, syntactic, KODI_OPTIONS, _dns_cache, _lock
    key = (str(portal['id']),kind)
    cursor = _cursor.get(key,0)%len(rows)
    cap = min(256 if kind=='live' else 24,len(rows))
    selected = [rows[(cursor+i)%len(rows)] for i in range(cap)]
    existing = read_many(portal['id'],kind,selected,provider_only=provider_only)
    records = [];retained74=[]
    deadline = time.monotonic()+1
    processed = 0
    for row in selected:
        if cancel() or time.monotonic()>deadline:
            break
        processed += 1
        for role,source in sources(row,provider_only=provider_only).items():
            prior=existing.get(str(row['sid']),{}).get(role,'')
            if not source or prior and not prior.startswith(('http://','https://')):
                continue
            uri = local_uri(source) or local_uri(cached(source))
            value = dict(uri='',mode='local',code='NO_SOURCE',until=time.time()+30)
            if uri:
                try:
                    with open(uri,'rb') as stream:
                        width,height=dimensions(stream.read(65536))
                    if 0<width<=4096 and 0<height<=4096 and width*height<=8*1024*1024:
                        value.update(uri=uri,code='LOCAL_HEADER_VALID',until=time.time()+86400)
                except (OSError, ValueError):
                    value['code']='INVALID_LOCAL_IMAGE'
            elif not persistent() and syntactic(source):
                approved = public_dns(source)
                parts = urlsplit(source)
                with _lock:
                    dns = _dns_cache.get((parts.hostname,parts.port or (443 if parts.scheme=='https' else 80)))
                remaining = max(0,min(30,dns[0]-time.monotonic())) if dns and approved and dns[1] else 0
                value.update(uri=source+KODI_OPTIONS if remaining else '',mode='dynamic',
                    code='DYNAMIC_APPROVED' if remaining else 'DNS_UNAVAILABLE',until=time.time()+(remaining or 5))
            else:
                value['code']='PENDING_LOCAL_DOWNLOAD' if syntactic(source) else 'INVALID_SOURCE'
            if value.get('mode')=='dynamic' and value.get('code')=='DYNAMIC_APPROVED':
                retained74.append((row['sid'],role,source,max(0,value['until']-time.time())))
            records.append((row['sid'],role,fingerprint(source),value))
            if len(records)>=64:
                _store(portal['id'],kind,records)
                records=[]
    if records:
        _store(portal['id'],kind,records)
    from widget_refs74 import remember_many
    remember_many(portal,kind,retained74)
    _cursor[key]=(cursor+processed)%len(rows)
    if len(_cursor)>16:
        _cursor.pop(next(iter(_cursor)))
    from widget_diagnostics47 import note,save
    refs=read_many(portal['id'],kind,selected[:processed],provider_only=provider_only)
    available=[uri for values in refs.values() for uri in values.values() if uri]
    value=note(portal['id'],kind,'ASSETS','REFERENCES_READY' if available else 'NO_RENDERABLE_REFERENCE',
        selected=processed,poster_sources=sum(bool(sources(r,provider_only=provider_only)['poster']) for r in selected[:processed]),
        logo_sources=sum(bool(sources(r,provider_only=provider_only)['poster']) for r in selected[:processed]) if kind=='live' else 0,
        dynamic_images=sum(uri.startswith(('http://','https://')) for uri in available),
        local_images=sum(not uri.startswith(('http://','https://')) for uri in available))
    save(portal['id'],kind,'ASSETS',value)


def channels(portal, records):
    """Store actual canonical IDs/labels, never a new parallel guide truth."""
    from programme_index46 import encoded, report
    db = None
    try:
        db = writer()
        with db:
            db.executemany('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO channels47 VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',
                [(str(portal['id']),str(e['sid']),str(e.get('canonical','')),
                  encoded({k:e[k] for k in ('channel','key','start','stop','source','revision') if k in e}),time.time())
                 for e in records[:64]])
    except (OSError, sqlite3.Error, ValueError, KeyError) as error:
        report('events',error)
    finally:
        if db is not None:
            db.close()


def remember_choice(pid, kind, sid, role, image):
    """Mirror an explicit Save, preserving the original SHA-named manual file.

    The common layer references an extension-correct verified display copy.
    Failure does not roll back the user's already valid legacy choice.
    """
    from media_sources43 import validate_image
    from programme_art46 import root, space, atomic
    from programme_index46 import encoded
    validate_image(image)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest()
    name = 'choice47-'+digest+('.png' if image.startswith(b'\x89PNG') else '.jpg')
    filename = os.path.join(root(),name)
    if os.path.islink(filename):
        raise OSError('UNSAFE_CHOICE_REFERENCE')
    if not os.path.isfile(filename):
        space(len(image))
        atomic(filename,image)
    with open(filename,'rb') as stream:
        if hashlib.sha256(stream.read(3*1024*1024+1)).hexdigest()!=digest:
            raise ValueError('CHOICE_REFERENCE_HASH')
    db = writer()
    try:
        with db:
            db.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO asset_refs47 VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?)',
                (str(pid),kind,str(sid),'choice_'+('poster' if role=='replacement' else role),digest,
                 encoded(dict(uri=filename,sha256=digest,mode='manual',code='READY')),time.time()+365*86400))
    finally:
        db.close()
    return filename


def choice(pid, kind, sid, role, digest):
    from programme_index46 import connect
    db = None
    try:
        db = connect(False)
        if db is None:
            return ''
        row = db.execute('SELECT fingerprint,data FROM asset_refs47 '
                         'WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=? AND role=?',
                         (str(pid),kind,str(sid),'choice_'+role)).fetchone()
        if row and row[0]==digest and len(row[1])<16384:
            value=json.loads(row[1])
            if value.get('sha256')==digest:
                filename=local_uri(value.get('uri',''))
                if filename:
                    with open(filename,'rb') as stream:
                        if hashlib.sha256(stream.read(3*1024*1024+1)).hexdigest()==digest:return filename
    except (OSError, sqlite3.Error, ValueError, TypeError):
        pass
    finally:
        if db is not None:
            db.close()
    return ''

    """Mirror an explicit Save, preserving the original SHA-named manual file.

    The common layer references an extension-correct verified display copy.
    Failure does not roll back the user's already valid legacy choice.
    """
    from media_sources43 import validate_image
    from programme_art46 import root, space, atomic
    from programme_index46 import encoded
    validate_image(image)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest()
    name = 'choice47-'+digest+('.png' if image.startswith(b'\x89PNG') else '.jpg')
    filename = os.path.join(root(),name)
    if os.path.islink(filename):
        raise OSError('UNSAFE_CHOICE_REFERENCE')
    if not os.path.isfile(filename):
        space(len(image))
        atomic(filename,image)
    with open(filename,'rb') as stream:
        if hashlib.sha256(stream.read(3*1024*1024+1)).hexdigest()!=digest:
            raise ValueError('CHOICE_REFERENCE_HASH')

                 encoded(dict(uri=filename,sha256=digest,mode='manual',code='READY')),time.time()+365*86400))
    finally:
        db.close()
    return filename

    from programme_index46 import connect
    db = None

            return ''
        row = db.execute('SELECT fingerprint,data FROM asset_refs47 '
                         'WHERE pid=? AND kind=? AND sid=? AND role=?',
                         (str(pid),kind,str(sid),'choice_'+role)).fetchone()
        if row and row[0]==digest and len(row[1])<16384:
            value=json.loads(row[1])

                filename=local_uri(value.get('uri',''))
                if filename:

                        if hashlib.sha256(stream.read(3*1024*1024+1)).hexdigest()==digest:return filename
    except (OSError, sqlite3.Error, ValueError, TypeError):
        pass
    finally:

    return ''

No image archive or network IO in presentation. DNS validation uses the existing
worker policy, expiry and Kodi redirect limits; only private bounded metadata is
persisted. Existing locally validated images and explicit choices win.
"""
import hashlib,json,os,tempfile,time
MAX_BYTES=65536


def path(pid):
    from utils import addon_data_dir
    return os.path.join(addon_data_dir(),'widget_art44_'+hashlib.sha256(str(pid).encode()).hexdigest()[:24]+'.json')


def read(pid):
    try:
        with open(path(pid),encoding='utf-8') as f:raw=f.read(MAX_BYTES+1)
        data=json.loads(raw) if len(raw)<=MAX_BYTES else {}
        return {k:v for k,v in data.items() if isinstance(k,str) and isinstance(v,dict) and isinstance(v.get('uri'),str) and isinstance(v.get('until'),(int,float))} if isinstance(data,dict) and len(data)<=96 else {}
    except (OSError,ValueError):return {}


def prepare(pid,rows):
    from artwork_config import persistent
    from media_art import sources,request
    request(rows,priority=0)
    if persistent():return
    from artwork_visible import public_dns,syntactic,KODI_OPTIONS,_dns_cache,_lock
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
    values=read(pid);now=time.time();values={k:v for k,v in values.items() if isinstance(v,dict) and v.get('until',0)>now}
    until=time.monotonic()+.4
    for row in rows[:24]:
        for url in sources(row):
            if not syntactic(url):continue
            key=hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).hexdigest();old=values.get(key)
            if old and old.get('until',0)>time.time()+15:continue
            if time.monotonic()>until:break
            if not public_dns(url):values.pop(key,None);continue
            p=urlsplit(url)
            with _lock:checked=_dns_cache.get((p.hostname,p.port or (443 if p.scheme=='https' else 80)))
            if checked and checked[1]:
                seconds=max(0,min(30,checked[0]-time.monotonic()))
                if seconds:values[key]=dict(uri=url+KODI_OPTIONS,until=time.time()+seconds)

    for binding in state.get('bindings',[])[:96]:

            hooks.extend(h for h in binding.get('hooks',[]) if h.startswith('XCMate.Widget45.Reload.') or h in ('widgetreload','widgetreload2','widgetreloadmovies','widgetreloadtvshows'))
    with _lock:
        _hooks[(str(portal['id']),kind)]=hooks
        _pending[(str(portal['id']),kind)]=(signature,count)


def poll():
    global _next,_focus
    from hero_epg63 import poll as hero63
    from skin_upgrade63 import poll as upgrade63
    hero63();upgrade63()
    import xbmc,xbmcgui
    if time.monotonic()<_next:return
    _next=time.monotonic()+1
    if xbmc.getSkinDir()!='skin.titan.bingie.mod' or xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowId()!=10000:return
    if xbmcgui.getCurrentWindowDialogId() not in (0,-1,9999):return
    from widget_home_probe59 import poll as observe_home59
    observe_home59()

    url=xbmc.getInfoLabel('ListItem.Property(XCMate.ProgrammeDetails46)')
    if isinstance(url,str) and len(url)<2048 and url.startswith('plugin://plugin.video.xtreammate/'):
        with _lock:_focus=url
    from widget_refresh45 import trace
    with _lock:pending=dict(_pending);hooks={k:list(v) for k,v in _hooks.items()}
    changes={}
    for key,(signature,count) in pending.items():
        if not hooks.get(key):trace('BLOCKED_NO_RELOAD_HOOK',key[1],count)
        for hook in hooks.get(key,[]):changes.setdefault(hook,[]).append((key[0],key[1],signature,count))
    now=time.monotonic();window=xbmcgui.Window(10000)
    for hook,values in changes.items():
        signature=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(values)).encode()).hexdigest();old=_seen.get(hook)
        if old and (old[0]==signature or now-old[1]<60):continue
        window.setProperty(hook,signature);_seen[hook]=(signature,now)
        for _,kind,_,count in values:trace('UPDATED',kind,count)


def focused():
    """Drain the legacy hint; focused ListItems already contain the final URL.

    Focus must not become a second metadata resolver, even on a worker. The
    rotating background prefetcher handles NOW/NEXT independently of input.
    """
    global _focus
    with _lock:_focus=None
